\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization}
\makeatletter
\let\NativeTickNode\tikz@dv@handle@tick
\def\tikz@dv@handle@tick#1{%
  \pgfextra{\typeout{DV-ENDPOINT \ProbeName: dir=\pgfkeysvalueof{/tikz/data visualization/direction axis}; value=\tikz@dv@tick@pos; low=\tikz@dv@min@tick; high=\tikz@dv@max@tick; anchor=#1}}%
  \NativeTickNode{#1}%
}
\tikzdatavisualizationset{every ticks/.append style={node style={
  name=nativetick,
  append after command={\pgfextra{%
    \pgf@process{\pgfpointanchor{nativetick}{center}}%
    \typeout{DV-CENTER \ProbeName: value=\tikz@dv@tick@pos; \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}%
  }}
}}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\def\ProbeName{school}
\tikz \datavisualization[school book axes,
  x axis={ticks={step=1}}, y axis={ticks={step=1}},visualize as line]
data point[x=-1,y=-1] data point[x=2,y=2];\par
\def\ProbeName{padding}
\tikz \datavisualization[scientific axes=clean,
  x axis={ticks={major={at={0,1,2 as [{tick text padding=1ex}] $p$,3,4},
    options at={1 as [{low=-5pt}]},no tick text at=3}}},
  y axis={ticks={step=1}},visualize as line]
data point[x=0,y=0] data point[x=4,y=2];\par
\def\ProbeName{stack}
\tikz \datavisualization[scientific axes=clean,
  x axis={ticks={step=1,major={stack=3pt}}},
  y axis={ticks={step=1,major={tick text padding=2pt,options at={1 as [{low=-6pt,high=1pt}]}}}},
  visualize as line]
data point[x=0,y=0] data point[x=4,y=2];
\end{document}
